queer_characters.name: Brian Slade
queer_characters.notes: Source states Slade openly discusses his bisexuality and embodies bisexual androgyny central to glam rock's aesthetic.

queer_characters.name: Curt Wild
queer_characters.notes: Depicted as uninhibited regarding sex and sexuality, embodying transgressive queerness; has an affair with Slade, a man. Bisexual/queer label supported by his same-sex relationship as described.

queer_characters.name: Arthur Stuart
queer_characters.notes: The film's ending, in which Arthur reconnects with Curt Wild suggesting reconciliation and personal growth, reads as an arc of queer self-discovery, but the source text does not explicitly label his sexuality.
queer_characters.contest_notes: Source text implies but does not explicitly state Arthur's own queerness; the reconnection with Wild is described as symbolic rather than confirmed romantic.

contributor_notes: Todd Haynes wrote and directed; source text does not state his identity, so he is omitted from queer_creators.
